title: app-showcase: "Mark Done" lets a member who may not edit tasks write them — the script body runs elevated, the action declares no requiredPermissions, and the console still offers the button
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"marchtian"} -->
_Requested by **田騏** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01VmuUhXU9SSUzqJYyXSmYSi?thread=cmsg_01VmuUhXU9SSUzqJYyXSmYSi7SkqaNxU2Ef8P2DMmp2hPJ)_

Found during an exploratory walkthrough of the showcase as a non-admin persona.

## Environment

- objectstack `main` @ `b9c7a8f`, `PORT=3000 pnpm dev` (showcase, fresh DB)
- objectui `main` @ `6fb31dc` console on :5180
- Signed in as the seeded persona `phone.demo@example.com` (Mei Phone)

## What the persona is allowed to do

The persona's grant on `showcase_task` is read + create only (the member-level set in `src/security/permission-sets.ts` carries `showcase_task: { allowRead: true, allowCreate: true }`). The console agrees: the task record page shows no **编辑 / Edit** button for this user, and a direct write is refused:

```
PATCH /api/v1/data/showcase_task/JVVzP8bTy9ZhbTCd  {"priority":"high"}
→ 403 {"code":"PERMISSION_DENIED","object":"showcase_task", ...}
```

## Steps

1. As the persona, open task **Content backlog** (it is assigned to the persona, so the select RLS lets it be read).
2. Click **Mark Done** in the record header.

## Actual

Toast "Task marked done.", and the write lands:

```
GET /api/v1/data/showcase_task/JVVzP8bTy9ZhbTCd
→ done: true, progress: 100, updated_by: usr_showcase_phone_demo
```

So a user who cannot edit a task can edit it through the action.

## Why it happens

This is the documented posture, not a runtime accident: a script action body is trusted application code and its `ctx.api` runs `isSystem` (`buildActionExecutionContext`; the `actionAiExposureError` docblock says a body's reads and writes "are NOT bounded by the caller's RLS/FLS"). The gate an author is expected to use is `requiredPermissions` (ADR-0066 D4, `actionPermissionError`). `showcase_mark_done` declares `capabilities: ['api.write']` and no `requiredPermissions`, and its `visible` predicate only checks `record.done`, so every reader of a task gets a working write button.

The showcase is the reference app people copy actions from, so the pattern it teaches is "a record-header script action that writes is open to every reader". The same shape probably applies to the other `api.write` actions in `src/ui/actions/index.ts`; I only exercised Mark Done. **Log Time** (`type: 'form'`) is also offered to this persona, but I did not check what its submit does for a user without edit.

## Expected

Either the showcase action is gated (a `requiredPermissions` entry, or a `visible`/`disabled` predicate tied to edit access) so the demo models the safe pattern, or the platform makes the gap visible to authors.

## Possible platform follow-ups (for triage, not part of the showcase fix)

- a lint warning for a script action whose body declares `api.write` and whose action declares no `requiredPermissions`, since that combination is always an elevation for every caller who can see the record;
- or the console hiding/disabling a record action that writes the current object when the caller's object permission has no `allowEdit`, the way it already hides Edit.
